_comment: Qt Creator project configuration for BookCLUB
_comment2: This file is informational — Qt Creator reads CMakeLists.txt + CMakePresets.json.

server._comment: Run from the source directory so database/schema.sql is found

client._comment: Run from the source directory so the server's DB is in the same location

tips: 1. Open CMakeLists.txt in Qt Creator (File → Open File or Project)
2. Select your Qt 6.11 MinGW kit when prompted
3. Use the 'default' preset — it auto-detects Qt from the kit
5. To run the server: select 'BookClubServer' as the active run configuration, Ctrl+R
6. To run the client: select 'BookClubClient' as the active run configuration, Ctrl+R
7. To run both: use scripts/run_both.bat from a terminal
8. The server must be running before the client can log in
10. The database (bookclub.db) is created in the working directory on first run
